hypotheses.lecture: Equilibrium Vs. Discount / Equilibrium Vs. Premium
hypotheses.claim: Kernel buys taken in discount (sells in premium) of the previous-day range earn more R than those taken on the wrong side of equilibrium.
hypotheses.scope: Month 9 kernel tickets (REV unless interpretation triggers on)
hypotheses.status: EXPLORATORY — not registered; pending CASSANDRA + DATA

hypotheses.claim: When the raided named extreme is a false breakout (the raid bar closes back inside the previous-day range), kernel tickets earn more R.
hypotheses.operationalisation: 15m raid bar close back inside [PDL, PDH] (above PDL for a low raid, below PDH for a high raid)
hypotheses.scope: Month 9 kernel tickets (REV unless interpretation triggers on)
hypotheses.status: EXPLORATORY — not registered; pending CASSANDRA + DATA

hypotheses.claim: Kernel tickets with fully aligned daytrade IOF (daily = 4h = 60m) earn more R than qualified ones.
hypotheses.scope: Month 9 kernel tickets (REV unless interpretation triggers on)
hypotheses.status: EXPLORATORY — not registered; pending CASSANDRA + DATA

hypotheses.claim: Kernel tickets whose post-raid displacement leaves a 15m FVG in the trade direction earn more R.
hypotheses.operationalisation: 3-bar 15m gap (buy: low[i] > high[i-2]; sell: high[i] < low[i-2]) between the raid bar and entry
hypotheses.scope: Month 9 kernel tickets (REV unless interpretation triggers on)
hypotheses.status: EXPLORATORY — not registered; pending CASSANDRA + DATA

hypotheses.operationalisation: buy: entry < mid(20-session high/low); sell: entry > mid
